description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… “Sandy Toes,” your dream getaway in the Villages of South Walton. With a thoughtful layout and an elevator, this elegant retreat feels like it was made for your group. Enjoy a zero-entry pool with kids or take a quick 3-minute tram ride to the beach. Explore boutique shops, gourmet dining, and the magical vibe of 30A on 7 beach bikes included. Perfect for a family reunion, friends’ trip, or a relaxing escape. Learn more below ...*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Community Pools & Hot Tub: A relaxing oasis just steps away, perfect for kids with Zero-Entry pool, adults, and everyone in between to splash and unwind.Prime Location: Stay connected to everything—just a 1-minute walk to the pool, a quick 3-minute tram ride to the beach, and steps from vibrant dining and shopping spots.Spacious Design: Room for everyone! With 5 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms, this home comfortably sleeps up to 16 guests, making it ideal for family reunions or group getaways.Elevator: Seamlessly access all levels—convenience and comfort combined for stress-free living.Gourmet Kitchen: Cook, create, and connect in a chef’s paradise featuring stainless steel appliances and sleek quartz countertops. Perfect for preparing memorable meals together.7 Beach Bikes: Explore the scenic beauty of Seacrest and neighboring beaches with 7 included bikes—adventure and freedom at your fingertips.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "Amazing house with a great location! Close to dining, shopping, and just a quick beach tram ride.” – Becca W.⭐ "Beautiful, spacious home! Everyone had plenty of room, and we loved having the pool so close.” – Allison B.⭐ "Perfect for a family getaway. Comfortable, convenient, and close to everything!” – Robert G.*** LIVING AREA ***The second-floor main living area offers an open-concept design, ideal for gathering with family or friends. Step out onto the balcony and enjoy the peaceful surroundings of 30A.Spacious open-concept main living areaSmart TV for entertainmentBalcony access for evening relaxation*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Cooking is a delight in the fully equipped gourmet kitchen, complete with a Wolf gas range and quartz countertops. The dining area features a formal table, with additional seating at the breakfast bar.Gourmet kitchen with top-tier appliancesDining table seating for 8Breakfast bar with seating for 4*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Each bedroom in this home is a sanctuary, designed for ultimate comfort and relaxation. Every room is outfitted with hotel-grade linens and smart TVs, ensuring a luxurious stay whether you're unwinding after a long day or catching up on your favorite shows.1st FloorBunk Nook: Full-over-Full Custom Bunk Bed (Sleeps 4).Queen Guest Bedroom: 2 Queen Beds (Sleeps 4), en-suite bathroom with tub/shower combo.2nd FloorBunk Room: Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, en-suite bathroom with walk-in shower.3rd FloorPrimary Suite: King bed, En-suite full bathroom with soaking tub and walk-in shower.King Guest Bedroom: King Bed, access to shared bathroom.Shared Bathroom: Full bathroom with tub/shower combo and dual vanities.Queen Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, access to shared bathroom.*** LOCATION, COMMUNITY & AMENITIES ***Sandy Toes is centrally located in the Villages of South Walton, offering resort-style amenities and easy access to 30A’s top attractions. Enjoy a gorgeous zero-entry pool, grilling stations, and a seasonal tram service to the beach. From pristine beaches to dining, shopping, and entertainment, everything is within reach.Zero-entry pool just steps away - Perfect for effortless relaxation and fun for the whole family.Gas grilling stations for outdoor dining - Savor laid-back evenings with a barbecue under the stars.Rosemary Beach (9-min walk) - Stroll to this charming coastal town, known for its cobblestone streets, stunning architecture, and relaxed, upscale vibe.Alys Beach (13-min walk) - Take a short walk to this picturesque community with its iconic white-washed buildings, giving off a serene and luxurious Mediterranean feel.Boutique shops, dining, and live music at Peddler’s Pavilion - Immerse yourself in the lively atmosphere with unique shopping, delicious food, and vibrant entertainment.Seasonal tram service to the beach - Enjoy a convenient ride to the sandy shores, making every beach trip stress-free.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased at checkout.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.This property has 7 bikes for guest use. To utilize the bikes, a waiver must be signed before the code is provided to the guest. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 96184STRO #: STR-096184
